title: Character creation: record level-1 class choices (fighting style, favored enemy, natural explorer, rogue expertise, level-1 subclass)
description: Found 2026-10-08 while planning eshyra-ug4i. Level-1 creation (packages/core/src/character/requiredChoices.ts Level1RequiredChoiceKind: skills/tools/equipment/cantrips/spells/spellcasting_ability/ability_increase/languages) never collects the class-feature choices the SRD makes at level 1: feature:fighter:fighting-style, feature:ranger:favored-enemy, feature:ranger:natural-explorer, feature:rogue:expertise, and the level-1 subclasses (feature:cleric:divine-domain, feature:sorcerer:sorcerous-origin, feature:warlock:otherworldly-patron). A finalized fighter therefore has no recorded fighting style, which also weakens the champion-10 no-repeat rule at level-up. Reuse the sheet featureChoices field and the selection validation eshyra-ug4i.3 adds; subclass at level 1 reuses the level-up subclass application.
acceptance_criteria:
- Level-1 creation collects, validates and durably records the class-feature choices the SRD makes at level 1 (fighting style, favored enemy, natural explorer, rogue expertise) on sheet.featureChoices (expertise in the durable expertise record eshyra-ug4i.1 defines). Auditability comes from the existing character-creation persistence and provenance (finalized sheet + its rules-pack/recipe/creationMode metadata); no new progression-ledger event kind or creation event contract.
- Level-1 subclasses (cleric divine domain, sorcerous origin, otherworldly patron) are chosen at creation and persisted correctly in sheet.subclass via the level-up subclass application, so their level-1 subclass features are granted and later level-ups see the subclass.
- Creation writes the structured CharacterSheet.spellcasting buckets (cantrips/known/spellbook/prepared per class) defined by eshyra-ug4i.2.1, not only the flat spells list.
- Representative finalized characters (fighter, ranger, rogue, cleric, sorcerer, warlock, wizard) round-trip through store and level up without legacy-classification fallbacks.
notes:
2026-10-08: when eshyra-ug4i.2 lands, creation should also write the structured CharacterSheet.spellcasting buckets (cantrips/known/spellbook/prepared) instead of only the flat spells list; the level-up path classifies legacy flat lists on first level-up.
From eshyra-ug4i.2.1: level-up now persists structured spell state on CharacterSheet.spellcasting ({cantrips, known?, spellbook?, prepared?, mysticArcanum?, designations?}, canonical spell refs, sheet.spells = derived union). Creation should write this field (wizard: cantrips + 6 spellbook spells [+prepared]; known casters: known; prepared casters: prepared) so sheets are not left as legacy flat lists; legacy sheets are classified at their first level-up (see levelUpSpells.ts effectiveSpellcasting).
2026-10-08 (Claude Captain reconciliation): scope confirmed after #610; acceptance criteria added (level-1 choice collection, correct subclass persistence, initial structured spellcasting). Rogue expertise depends on the record shape eshyra-ug4i.1 introduces — sequence after it or share the shape.
2026-10-08 (Claude Captain): acceptance corrected per review — the required invariant is durable, auditable recording of creation choices, not progression-ledger rows. ProgressionEventKind is only xp-award | milestone-award | level-up; creation persists via the finalized sheet and its provenance metadata. Adding a creation ledger event would be unrequested architectural expansion.
From eshyra-91o0.1 (commit fd5a1236 on branch eshyra-91o0.1, pending integration): the pack now carries feature:draconic-bloodline:dragon-ancestor choices[] = {id dragon-ancestor, category other, choose 1, level 1, 10 options dragon-ancestor:<slug>, text 'Dragon: Black; Damage Type: Acid'}. Creation-time collection/persistence (featureChoices) is yours; the audit gate now covers level-1 subclass-granted features. Also now modeled for any L1/early subclass flow: college-of-lore skills (category skill, from 18 skill names).
PR opened (head 78c5a881) 2026-10-09; supervisor reviewed + verify green. Stays in_progress until merge. Follow-ups eshyra-jah7, eshyra-eb9n.
